content.json:
# AMBA Alert Health Workbook

Monitors alert routing health across all AMBA-managed subscriptions.

---

content.query:
AlertsManagementResources
| where type == 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/alerts'
| where properties.essentials.startDateTime >= ago(24h)
| where properties.essentials.monitorCondition == 'Fired'
| extend severity = tostring(properties.essentials.severity)
| extend targetResource = tostring(properties.essentials.targetResource)
| extend alertRule = tostring(properties.essentials.alertRule)
| summarize AlertCount = count() by severity
| order by severity asc
content.title: Fired Alerts by Severity (24h)

content.query:
AlertsManagementResources
| where type == 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/alerts'
| where properties.essentials.startDateTime >= ago(7d)
| where properties.essentials.monitorCondition == 'Fired'
| extend alertTime = todatetime(properties.essentials.startDateTime)
| summarize AlertCount = count() by bin(alertTime, 1h)
| order by alertTime asc
content.title: Alert Volume Trend (7 days)

content.query:
resources
| where type == 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/actionrules'
| extend ruleName = name
| extend enabled = tostring(properties.enabled)
| extend ruleType = tostring(properties.type)
| extend scope = tostring(properties.scopes)
| project ruleName, enabled, ruleType, subscriptionId, resourceGroup
| order by ruleName asc
content.title: Alert Processing Rules Status

content.query:
resources
| where type == 'microsoft.insights/actiongroups'
| where tags['_deployed_by_amba'] == 'True'
| extend agName = name
| extend emailReceivers = array_length(properties.emailReceivers)
| extend webhookReceivers = array_length(properties.webhookReceivers)
| extend armRoleReceivers = array_length(properties.armRoleReceivers)
| extend enabled = tostring(properties.enabled)
| project agName, enabled, emailReceivers, webhookReceivers, armRoleReceivers, subscriptionId, resourceGroup
| order by agName asc
content.title: AMBA Action Groups

content.query:
AlertsManagementResources
| where type == 'microsoft.alertsmanagement/alerts'
| where properties.essentials.monitorCondition == 'Fired'
| where properties.essentials.alertState == 'New'
| extend age = datetime_diff('hour', now(), todatetime(properties.essentials.startDateTime))
| where age > 24
| extend alertRule = tostring(properties.essentials.alertRule)
| extend severity = tostring(properties.essentials.severity)
| extend targetResource = tostring(properties.essentials.targetResource)
| extend startTime = todatetime(properties.essentials.startDateTime)
| project alertRule, severity, targetResource, startTime, age
| order by age desc
| take 50
content.title: Stale Alerts (>24h unacknowledged)

content.query:
resources
| where tags['_deployed_by_amba'] == 'True'
| summarize Count = count() by type
| order by Count desc
content.title: AMBA-Deployed Resources by Type
